subject: design/feature-draft-reopen
statement: Lock preparation refuses a reopened draft whose PRD and tech-spec text equal the binding version's, naming the remedy: abandon the draft (`design:feature-draft-v1` §3.14). There is no change to lock, and a version number marks a contract change. The binding version stays, no lock tag is written, and the abandonment keeps the reason (`design-brainstorm:feature-draft-tech-design-2#D-3`; #DINV-7).
